meta.title_plain: How Brawl Stars almost got deleted before it was born
meta.teaser: Supercell tested Brawl Stars for 522 days and nearly cancelled it.

page.title: The game that was almost deleted: how Brawl Stars survived
page.sub: The story of Supercell and Brawl Stars
page.bigIdea: Supercell only keeps games that are truly fun. Brawl Stars nearly got cut, but the team kept changing it until it worked.

cards.title: Tiny teams called cells
cards.front: Supercell is a game company in Helsinki, Finland, started in 2010.
cards.back: Games are made by small teams of 5 to 7 people, called cells. The team itself decides if its game lives or gets cancelled.
cards.tryit: Pick 4 friends. If you made a game together, what job would each person do?

cards.title: Test it in Canada first
cards.front: In June 2017, Brawl Stars quietly appeared in Canada's App Store.
cards.back: This is a soft launch: a test in a few countries first. If players don't stick around, the game gets cancelled.
cards.tryit: Show a friend a game idea. Watch their face. Do they want to keep playing?

cards.title: 522 days of changes
cards.front: The test lasted 522 days. Almost everything changed.
cards.back: It began in portrait mode, where you tapped to move. Players liked joysticks, so it flipped sideways and went from 2D to 3D.
cards.tryit: Play Brawl Stars for 5 minutes. Notice how both thumbs share the work.

cards.title: Spike began as numbers
cards.front: Spike, the cactus Brawler, didn't start as a cactus.
cards.back: First, designers made a balanced list of his attacks. Then artists turned those numbers into a cactus in overalls.
cards.tryit: Invent a Brawler: write 3 attacks first, then draw what he looks like.

cards.title: Cancelled games teach lessons
cards.front: Supercell has cancelled many games, even some that tested well.
cards.back: They celebrate what each failure taught them. Brawl Stars nearly got cut too, then launched worldwide on 12 December 2018.
cards.tryit: Think of a tennis match you lost. Write one thing it taught you.

page.think: The Brawl Stars team kept changing their game for 522 days instead of giving up. What's something you do, in tennis or in games, that could get better if you changed one big thing?
